plan.title: limma-trend DE: treated vs control muscle
plan.analytical_narrative: The core facility delivered log2(TPM+1) values (12000 genes x 12 samples; 6 treated vs 6 control, human muscle, unpaired, single batch), not counts, so count models (DESeq2, edgeR, voom) are ruled out by the data state. The plan therefore (1) verifies sample structure and the log2 scale on the delivered values as-is, (2) fits a limma linear model with trend=TRUE and robust=TRUE on a mean-log-expression-filtered gene set, testing treated vs control with control as the explicit reference, selecting genes by BH-adjusted p < 0.05 and additionally reporting a treat-based list tested against a minimal effect threshold of 0.25 log2 units, and (3) writes a reproducible report with method, thresholds, n_tested/n_de, and session information. No batch, covariate, or pairing terms exist in metadata.csv (condition only), so the design is ~condition. Gene identifiers are used exactly as delivered; the identifier space observed in log_expr.csv is stated in the report rather than assumed.
